This is a redirect from a randomly generated non-player/computer-controlled character name from a video game.

For more information, please see [[List of computer-controlled character names in Battlefront games|List of computer-controlled character names in ''Battlefront'' games]], [[List of computer-controlled character names in Star Wars: Squadrons|List of computer-controlled character names in ''Star Wars: Squadrons'']], and ''[[Ewok Village]]''.<includeonly>{{SpecialCategorizer|[[Category:Redirects from randomly generated NPC names]]}}</includeonly><noinclude>

==Usage==
See '''{{Tl|Bfname}}''' for redirects to [[List of computer-controlled character names in Battlefront games|List of computer-controlled character names in ''Battlefront'' games]]. Otherwise, replace the contents of a suitable page with the following code to be used as a redirect:

<pre>
#REDIRECT [[PAGENAME]]

{{R_from_random_NPCs}}
</pre>
